name: Wo yu Wo Xingjiang Liqu de Xiaoyou.
original_name: 我与我行将离去的小友。
source:
“I want to fall head over heels for someone before I die.”
That’s what the girl said to me one summer day, a year ago.

Unlike the rest of us, stuck in our aimless lives, she didn’t know how much time she had left or how far she could go.
During a brief “journey” that lasted only a few days, my stagnant life was gently nudged forward.

And what will the end of this journey look like?

[Translated from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1110720/]steam[/url]]
